title: Butternut Squash Soup with Apple
description: This creamy butternut squash soup with apple and carrots is perfectly seasoned with nutmeg for a wonderfully warm and comforting fall soup.
ingredients: 2 large leeks (white and pale green parts only), chopped
1 Granny Smith apple, peeled, cored, and sliced 1/4-inch thick

steps.text: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Stir in leeks and onions; cook and stir until onion softens and turns translucent, about 5 minutes. Add potato, squash, carrots, apple, and chicken stock. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until vegetables are soft, about 20 minutes.

Carefully purée soup in batches in a blender, or use a stick blender to purée soup in the pot. Once soup is puréed, return it to the pot and stir in wine and cream. Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper; simmer gently for 5 minutes. Ladle into bowls and garnish with chopped chives.

video.description: Bring all the flavors of Autumn together in a medley of vegetables that bring warm comfort in every delicious spoonful. Cook leeks and onions in butter, then add potato, butternut squash, carrots, Granny Smith apple and chicken stock. Simmer, puree, and add dry white wine and cream with some nutmeg, salt and pepper. Serve up wonderfully fragrant with a dollop of crème fraiche or sour cream and a sprinkling of freshly chopped chives.
video.name: Butternut and Apple Harvest Soup
